### Always Reforming
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/always-reforming
Passage: Nehemiah 13:30-31
Points:
- External religious conformity and physical security cannot replace genuine inward repentance.
- Marrying unbelieving foreigners threatened to reintroduce idolatry into the covenant community.
- Choosing personal preferences over obedience to God exposed widespread spiritual compromise.
- Human reformations inevitably lose momentum unless sustained by genuine saving faith.
- Constant preaching and hearing of the gospel remains necessary in every generation.

### Bible Pathway - June 11, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-june-11-2010-11633002.html
Passage: Nehemiah 13:25-26
Points:
- Spiritual leaders and nobles compromised God's covenant through intermarriage with pagan idol worshipers.
- Nehemiah warned the people against compromise by recalling how foreign wives led King Solomon into sin.
- God's people make an impact when they know the Scriptures and refuse spiritual compromise.
- Nehemiah's purification of the priesthood points forward to Christ cleansing believers from all sin.
